issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%), the lava stream descending the dark slope (also visible mid-frame in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the lava reads as a procedural emissive shader with uniform orange-red contour outlines painted over a smooth, clay-like dark grey chute; the rock directly touching the molten stream receives almost no bounce light or specular reflection and shows no physical depth or broken crust
issues.fix: give the lava stream recessed channel geometry, rough fractured basalt crust with fine micro-detail, and strong local orange illumination and specular sheen on the immediately adjacent rock

issues.where: the lower rim and left edge of the cave mouth (also visible in set-B-05.png, top-left crop x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: a hard horizontal seam and flat grey shelf lip mark where the cave mesh meets the cliff wall, and the left cave rim has jagged low-poly faceted rock spikes
issues.fix: blend the cave opening seamlessly into the cliff geometry with continuous strata and higher-resolution sculpted rock edges

issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%), the foreground creature's lower front legs
issues.what: the leg joints show blocky polygonal faceting, a small detached floating shard sits to the right of the lower joint, and the skin reads as stretched clay with no dust or ash from the ground on it
issues.fix: subdivide and smooth the leg joint geometry, remove the floating polygon artifact, add fine organic skin detail, and dust the lower legs and feet with ash

issues.where: right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%), the glowing lava cracks across the ground (also visible lower right of set-B-01.png)
issues.what: the lava fissures look like flat glowing orange patches with dark-red rims sitting on top of the terrain, with no recessed depth or crust and almost no light cast onto the surrounding soil and pebbles
issues.fix: recess the fissures into the ground with jagged crusted edges and have each glowing crack cast warm light onto nearby stones and dirt

issues.where: the three small steam puffs rising from the ground lava cracks (left-center, near the tendrils, and beneath the right creature)
issues.what: the isolated puffs read as cool grey-white wisps that pick up almost no orange light from the bright lava directly beneath them
issues.fix: light the base and core of each vapour plume with warm orange scatter from the lava underneath and break up their similar isolated shapes

issues.where: cliff rock crops (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42% and x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%) and cave interior crop (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: at native resolution the cliff rock textures are soft, muddy, and stretched over flat planes, while the cave interior is a flat featureless dark void with a smooth low-detail ceiling
issues.fix: increase cliff texture and displacement detail for 4K delivery and add layered rock structure and subtle bounced lava light inside the cave

issues.where: right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%), the orange haze over the lower-right basin (also visible lower right of set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the fog reads as a flat uniform orange tint wash with no volumetric structure or depth variation
issues.fix: replace the flat orange gradient with layered, wispy volumetric fume that catches light unevenly from the lava below

issues.where: the hooves of the foreground and right-side creatures where they meet the ground
issues.what: contact shadows under the feet are weak and there is no ground indentation or dust disturbance, making the feet look lightly perched on the terrain
issues.fix: tighten ambient occlusion and contact shadows directly under each foot and add slight dust displacement around the hooves

issues.where: top-right crop (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%), the upper shoulder and ridge of the foreground creature
issues.what: subtle polygonal faceting is visible along the dark silhouette edge and the hide has a slightly clay-like surface finish
issues.fix: increase silhouette mesh resolution and add finer surface roughness variation and micro-creasing
